faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate -I position at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate -I post at NIT Raipur is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate -I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Optics, Optoelectronics, or a related field, along with a valid CSIR/UGC-NET or GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate -I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PH and female candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate -I post?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on the qualification (GATE/CSIR/UGC/NET).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project Associate -I recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line clearly states the post applied for.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate -I position?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on an Interview, which will be conducted in a hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for the Project Associate -I recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview for the Project Associate -I position is scheduled for 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Project Associate -I position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010.
